plan.title: SRC-CVT-004 — Reject low starting price on RFQ conversion

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary for the buyer-side conversion case.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where conversion is available.
Open the RFQ-to-Auction conversion flow and continue to the converted auction create screen.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, set the starting price below the largest global charge among the RFQ bids, publish the auction, and stop when the application shows the refusal.

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for setting the converted auction starting price or publishing this specific invalid conversion configuration.

args.text: Starting price cannot be less than the maximum global charge of RFQ bids
